items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Manuel Moneta. Do you know Manuel Moneta? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, he lived, he lived in Algiers.

ctx.x: You never hear too much said about the Turk. But if ever you see Louis Armstrong, you ask him about the Turk.
Well, I know his brother, and, uh, uh, Manuel Moneta. Do you know Manuel Moneta?
Yes, he lived, he lived in Algiers.
